source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains aspiration and work rather than importing an institutional title too quickly.
key_decisions.before: This saying is trustworthy: if anyone aspires to oversight, they desire a good work.
key_decisions.after: This saying is trustworthy: If anyone aspires to oversight, that person desires a good work.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The saying is trustworthy: if anyone aspires to the office of overseer, he desires a noble work.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps male marital idiom and the full positive list.
key_decisions.before: Therefore an overseer must be above accusation, faithful to one spouse, sober, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
key_decisions.after: Therefore, an overseer must be above reproach, a one-woman man, sober, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable and able to teach;
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Therefore the overseer must be above reproach, the husband of one wife, sober-minded, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps male household headship, children and seriousness.
key_decisions.before: managing their own household well, having children who are respectful and obedient,
key_decisions.after: managing his own household well and keeping his children submissive with complete dignity.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He must manage his own household well, with all dignity keeping his children submissive,

key_decisions.rationale: Retains the rhetorical analogy and masculine referent.
key_decisions.before: because if someone does not know how to care for their own household, how will they care for God’s church?
key_decisions.after: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how will he care for God's church?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: for if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how will he care for the church of God?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps pride's danger and the ambiguous genitive relation to the devil.
key_decisions.before: The overseer must not be a recent convert, so that they do not become conceited and fall into the devil’s judgment.
key_decisions.after: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall into the devil's condemnation.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become puffed up and fall into the judgment of the devil.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves women as the stated group without deciding between women ministers and wives.
key_decisions.before: Women likewise must be dignified, not slanderers, sober, faithful in everything.
key_decisions.after: Women likewise must be dignified, not slanderers, sober and faithful in everything.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Likewise, women must be dignified, not slanderers, but sober-minded, faithful in all things.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the repeated male marital and household qualifications.
key_decisions.before: Deacons must be faithful to one spouse, managing their children and their households well.
key_decisions.after: Let ministers be one-woman men, managing their children and their own households well.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Let servants be husbands of one wife, managing their children and their households well.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the pinned relative pronoun and all six balanced lines.
key_decisions.before: And without question, great is the mystery of godliness: He was revealed in flesh, set right in Spirit, seen by angels, proclaimed among the nations, trusted in throughout the world, taken up in glory.
key_decisions.after: And undeniably great is the mystery of godliness: He was revealed in flesh, vindicated in spirit, seen by angels, proclaimed among the nations, believed in the world and taken up in glory.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And without controversy, great is the mystery of godliness: He was revealed in the flesh, vindicated in the Spirit, seen by angels, proclaimed among the nations, believed in the world, taken up in glory.
